narration: 昨年は現場近くを探していましたが、今回はさらに広い範囲での捜索となりました。
scene: 見渡すかぎりの山林を、ドローン視点でゆっくり進む。尾根の上に、オレンジのベストの捜索隊が小さく一列に見え、その先に山また山が続く（実写）。174〜179のキャラの連続を切るため、ここは実写の動画にする。

fences.label: 静止画プロンプト（16:9・フォトリアル）:
fences.text: A high aerial drone view over a vast sea of forested ridges and deep valleys rolling away to the horizon inland from Setana, southwestern Hokkaido, in April early spring: layer after layer of leafless brown deciduous forest with dark green conifers, a winding valley road far below, the Sea of Japan faint on the far left, No snow anywhere, no snow patches on the slopes, no frost, no ice, no winter. On a bare ridge in the lower third of the frame, a tiny single file of five Japanese searchers in blaze-orange vests walks along the ridgeline, very small against the enormous forest, no face visible. Captured as a frozen moment. The upper third left as clean open space. Daunting, wide, soft overcast light, muted natural tones. Photorealistic, shot on RED camera. Documentary style. 16:9 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
